title: Polydorus
summary: Raleigh names Polydorus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Polydorus, a Prince of eminent vertues, who succeeded his father, raigned threescore yeeres, and out-liued the Messeniack Warre. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXIII, §. VI, sig. 344a
